start: A person on their phone opens the gym's 'Become a member' link app.mettleup.fit/m/<GYM CODE>

must_not: A blank page
Another gym's name or plans

steps.action: Type the name and mobile number, tap 'Verify with WhatsApp', send the WhatsApp message it opens, come back
must_not: A number marked checked without the WhatsApp message
The typed name lost on coming back

steps.action: Tap 'Next', on 'Step 2 of 3' 'Your plan' pick a plan and a start day, tap 'Next'
user_sees: Each plan with the gym's own price
The total for the picked plan
must_not: A price different from the gym's plan in the panel
A start day before today allowed

steps.action: On 'Step 3 of 3' 'Agree and send' tick both boxes, keep 'Pay at the desk', tap 'Send to the gym'
must_not: Two enquiries for one tap
A request saved in another gym
A price the page made up sent to the gym

start: The gym has switched on a free trial; the person is on Step 2

steps.action: Pick the free trial above the plans, pick the start day, tap Next
user_sees: 'The free trial costs nothing. You do not pay anything on this page.'
must_not: Any amount to pay
A 'Pay now' button

steps.action: Tick both boxes and tap 'Start my free trial'
must_not: The person shown as a member
A payment started

start: The gym takes online payment; the person is on Step 3

steps.action: Pick 'Pay now (UPI or card)' and tap 'Send to the gym'
must_not: The request lost when the payment cannot be made
A different amount from the plan total

user_sees: The done screen without the pay button
must_not: The request removed

start: The person is on Step 3 with everything filled

steps.action: Tap 'Send to the gym' without ticking the boxes
user_sees: A line under the boxes asking to tick them
must_not: Anything sent

steps.action: Send with a number that is already a member of this gym
user_sees: 'This number is already a member of this gym. You can renew your plan instead.'
must_not: A second member made
The old member changed

steps.action: Pick the free trial with a number that already used one here
user_sees: 'You have already used a free trial at this gym with this mobile number. Please pick a plan to join.'
Back on Step 2 with no plan picked
must_not: A second free trial given

steps.action: Send more than 10 forms in a day from one Wi-Fi
user_sees: 'Too many sign-ups were sent today. Please try again tomorrow, or join at the gym desk.'
must_not: 'Sent to <gym>' shown for a refused send

start: The person filled Step 1 and 2; meanwhile the owner changes the gym

steps.action: The owner switches the free trial off; the person taps Send with the trial picked
user_sees: 'This gym is not offering free trials right now. Please pick a plan to join.'
Back on Step 2 with the plans reloaded
must_not: A trial started after it was switched off

steps.action: The owner changes the picked plan; the person taps Send
user_sees: Back on Step 2 with the new plans and a line that the plan changed
must_not: The old price sent

steps.action: The owner turns online sign-ups off; the person opens the link again
user_sees: '<gym> is not taking sign-ups online right now'
must_not: The form shown

steps.action: The gym opens Enquiries in the panel
user_sees: The person's name, number, plan and start day in that gym only
must_not: The number shown to any other gym
The number kept by the page itself
A price taken from what the page sent
